newsitem.title: USA: Trans World Airlines Dec load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Trans World Airlines Dec load factor rises.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Tuesday its passenger load factor rose 3.7 points to 65.8 percent.
Revenue passenger miles for the month rose 11.4 percent to 2.15 billion, while available seat miles gained 5.2 percent to 3.27 billion.
For all of 1996, passenger load factor rose 1.1 points to 66.8 percent.
Revenue passenger miles for the year gained 8.9 percent to 27.11 billion, and available seat miles rose 7.1 percent to 40.59 billion.
